justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: LSS is a common credential among clinicians moving into hospital ops, payer ops, and consulting, but it is rarely the sole driver of placement into pure health-tech vendor roles.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Appears moderately in payer (UnitedHealth, Elevance) and provider-ops postings and occasionally in Epic/Oracle Health implementation-consulting roles, but is not a core requirement at EHR vendors.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: ASQ and industry salary surveys show a roughly 10-20% wage premium for Black Belts over non-certified peers in healthcare ops roles.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Builds statistical, DMAIC, and process-mapping fluency but limited coding, data-engineering, or informatics depth.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Strong narrative bridge for PTs/OTs;reframes clinical workflow experience as process-improvement expertise valued by hospital and payer employers.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Green Belt is achievable in 4-8 weeks for $1-3K online; Black Belt 3-6 months for $2-5K, making it relatively low cost and time.
